en: Black‑and‑white view along a tree‑lined riverside promenade. On the left is a shaded footpath under dense foliage, with a low stone wall bordering the path to the right. Beyond the wall is a broad river with a low weir or rapids. On the opposite bank, on a small hill, stands a large villa or small palace with a steep tower and multiple stories, surrounded by trees and a few neighboring buildings. The overall style is early‑20th‑century European. No visible text on the image.
